en.askTitle: Swap in your own arrival date, salary and rent limit to get a Berlin rent and landing-cost plan
en.runTitle: A non-EU developer moving to Berlin on EUR 62,000: finding a first flat within six weeks

fields.label: Arrival date and household
fields.value: moving for a job that starts on 1 March 2027, single

fields.label: Salary, contract and health insurer
fields.value: EU Blue Card, gross salary EUR 62,000 a year

fields.label: Rent limit
fields.placeholder: e.g. no more than EUR 1,300 a month all-in

en.template: Plan my Berlin move for {arrival}, with {salary}, {office}, {cash} and {rentLimit}. Show take-home assumptions, dated whole-home adverts, all-in rent, deposits and landing costs. Include registration, newcomer documents, scam checks and a backup if the search takes longer. Keep EUR unchanged; do not contact, apply, book, pay or publish.

phases.title: Read the rental and registration rules, check how take-home pay is calculated, and collect dated adverts
phases.note: Berlin rent rules, registration, deposit, scams, tax and social contributions
phases.judgment: It caught a rule that is easy to misread: the three-month registration exemption for short stays is not permission to wait, because someone planning to stay long-term must register within two weeks. It also found that older official pages show a stale 2025 end date for Berlin’s rent cap, and the Senate’s own announcement says 31 December 2029.

phases.title: Build the rent table and test it against estimated take-home pay
phases.judgment: It labelled the take-home figure for what it is: about EUR 3,215 a month under 2026 tax rules, not confirmed 2027 payroll, because no final 2027 calculation had been published and draft reforms were deliberately left out.

phases.title: Write the guide and sources list, then run one final check
phases.judgment: It kept the limits of the rent examples in view: the adverts are November price examples, not confirmed March availability, and any cold rent it could not see is marked as unknown rather than guessed.

workers: Read primary sources on registration, the paperwork landlords ask for, deposit limits, Berlin’s rent cap and scam warnings
Worked out a transparent estimate of monthly take-home pay on EUR 62,000 from the official tax and social-contribution rules

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的抵达日期、工资和租金上限，得到柏林租房与落脚费用规划
zh.runTitle: 非欧盟程序员以 62,000 欧元年薪搬到柏林：六周内找到第一套房

fields.label: 抵达日期及家庭情况
fields.value: 为 3 月 1 日（2027 年）开始的工作搬家，单身

fields.label: 工资、合同和保险机构
fields.value: 欧盟蓝卡，税前年薪 62,000 欧元

fields.label: 办公室地点
fields.placeholder: 例如：亚历山大广场附近

fields.label: 租金上限
fields.placeholder: 例如：全包每月不超过 1,300 欧元

zh.template: 请规划我的柏林搬迁：抵达日期及家庭{arrival}，工资、合同和保险机构{salary}，办公室{office}，可用现金{cash}，租金上限{rentLimit}。列出到手工资假设、带日期的整套房源、全部租金、押金和落脚费用，加入住址登记、新来者材料、防骗核对和找房延误的备用方案。保留 EUR，不要联系、申请、预订、付款或发布。

phases.title: 阅读租房和住址登记规则，核对到手工资算法，收集带日期的房源
phases.note: 柏林租房规则、住址登记、押金、防骗、税和社保
phases.judgment: 它抓出了一条容易看错的规则：短期居留可免登记三个月的说法，并不等于可以拖着不登记，打算长期居住的人应在两周内登记；它还发现旧的官方页面把柏林租金上限的到期日写成过时的 2025 年，而市政府自己的公告写的是 2029 年 12 月 31 日。

phases.title: 做出租金表，并对照预计的到手工资检验
phases.judgment: 它把到手工资的性质说清楚了：按 2026 年税制大约每月 3,215 欧元，不是已确认的 2027 年工资单，因为 2027 年的最终算法还没公布，草案中的改革也刻意没有计入。

phases.title: 写成指南和来源清单，最后做一次整体检查
phases.judgment: 它没有夸大租金示例：房源是 11 月的价格样本，不代表 3 月仍有房，看不到的冷租金标为未知，而不是猜一个数。

workers: 阅读一手资料：住址登记、房东会要的材料、押金上限、柏林租金上限和防骗提醒
依据官方税和社保规则，算出 62,000 欧元年薪对应的每月到手工资，写清每一步假设
